# Cookie basket (pedestal replacement)

**Status: placeholder.** Generated pixel art and models; a human may repaint the atlases or polish the models in Blockbench later (keep file names, UV layout and sizes).
**Originality:** original work by Pixel Pat, generated by `design/scripts/basket.py`.

## Pipeline
Plain resource pack, namespace `cookieclicker`, Paper 26.3 (pack format 97.1, unchanged).
- Item model definition `resourcepack/assets/cookieclicker/items/cookie_basket.json`: `minecraft:select` on `minecraft:custom_model_data`, `index` 0 (string), cases `<tier>_<fill>`, fallback `wicker_0`.
- Models `models/item/basket/<tier>_<fill>.json` (15), textures `textures/item/basket/<tier>.png` (one atlas per tier: wicker/bushel 128x128, golden 256x256; 2 texels per model unit).
- Generator `design/scripts/basket.py` (deterministic, runs in `mise run assets`).

## IDs for the code
- `item_model` = `cookieclicker:cookie_basket` (base material anything, e.g. `Material.COOKIE`).
- Custom model data **string** at index 0 = `<tier>_<fill>`: tiers `wicker`, `bushel`, `golden`; fill `0`..`4` (`0` empty, `4` heaped). Example `golden_4`. Unknown strings show `wicker_0`.
- ItemDisplay, transform NONE, scale 1. The basket's **bottom is at model y 8** (an ItemDisplay with transform NONE draws the model centre (8,8,8) at its position), so the display position = floor point, x/z centre of the cell; every element is shifted +8 on y and the generator asserts the lowest element y == 8. Models reach y 16.0 (wicker) to 27 (golden heap), within the -16..32 limit. Widths and top heights below are unchanged, in blocks above the display position. All four sides are identical, so the 180 degree Y turn of item displays does not matter (no front).

## Sizes (1 block = 16 model units at scale 1)
Width is the full footprint (square, centred). **Top height** = height of the pile (or the rim when empty) at the basket centre, in blocks: float the cookie above this (+ gap).

Notes: golden has four corner posts up to **0.688** blocks, at the corners only. The pile top is measured at the centre and steps down towards the edges (stepped pyramid, 4 layers). For golden_0 and golden_1 (centre tops 0.56 and 0.63) the posts are higher than the centre, so keep the cookie's lowest point above about 0.69 there if it is wide.

## Look
- wicker: small woven straw basket, twisted rim.
- bushel: bigger willow basket, two copper bands, copper rim.
- golden: gold-woven body, gold rim and band, gold corner posts; from fill 3 four cookies spill over the rim, fill 4 is a tall heap.
- The cookie pile uses the cookie's dough ramp and chocolate chips (see `design/cookie.md`), painted as stacked discs on top and as flat ellipses on the sides.
- No element rotations; all coordinates inside -16..32 (golden spans x/z -3..19).
